test_title: PYST 25: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the following sentence.

If it is sunny tomorrow, we __go__ for a picnic.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the** verb **form should match the conditional structure.
 
• The sentence uses a** future conditional structure "If it is sunny tomorrow," which should be followed by "will" + base form of the verb.**
 
• Hence, the correct form is** "will go"** instead of just **"go."**

Hence, the correct statement:** *If it is sunny tomorrow, we will go for a picnic*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The future conditional structure in English often follows the pattern** "If + present simple, will + base verb."**
 
• Example: ***If it rains, we will stay indoors.***
